title: PassagesResponse
description: Answer of the core service's GET /v1/passages?unit=<unit>: the passages of a unit a learner may read (an explainer or a news item with no safety flag under the default rule), current versions only, ordered by id.

id.description: The pinned Source version (voa:<article>@<rules version>). Contains '/' and ':': URL-encode it as a path segment of GET /v1/passages/{id}.

url.description: The VOA page the passage comes from, for the credit.
